question_defect: The printed phrase "co-efficient of a real expansion" is a corruption of "coefficient of areal expansion" (the space is in the wrong place). Read literally it says "real expansion", which is a liquid-expansion term and has no meaning for a solid sheet; the intended quantity is unambiguous only because the options fit the areal reading.
notes: Solved independently before reading the solution: for an isotropic solid the areal (superficial) expansivity is beta = 2 alpha, so alpha : beta = 1 : 2 = 0.5, option 2. Checked both distractor entries numerically: reversing the ratio gives 2 (option 1, printed "2") and cubical-to-areal 3alpha/2alpha gives 1.5 (option 4, printed "1.5") - both entries name the option that their own text produces. The why_this_step binomial argument (1+alpha dT)^2 ~ 1+2 alpha dT is correct. Considered filing difficulty=medium as weak for what is a one-line definition recall, but did not: the corrupted wording in the question makes "medium" defensible, so it is not clearly off.
